info.title: Sophon CLI
info.description: Sophon — enterprise AI personal assistant CLI. Chat, manage agents/skills/workflows/channels, approve tool calls, run scheduled jobs, and drive remote desktop nodes from your terminal. Installs the 'sophon' command globally.

options.name: --open-browser
options.description: Open Dashboard in browser after start [default: True]

options.description: Skip the About You personalization wizard at the end of setup [default: False]
